workflow: Post Composer prepares a content package.
Operator sends package to protected backend endpoint.
Backend validates fields and stores package as draft or ready item in KV.
Publishing to static public pages requires a separate approved deploy/write process.
Every package must be logged with timestamp and operator identity.
safety_rules: No direct public publishing without explicit backend policy.
ready_to_publish still requires protected endpoint and log.
Legal, financial, media and dispute content requires human review.
No API keys or GitHub tokens in frontend.
